text:
emily.cs: Quick heads-up — Borealis renewal due 2025-07-15 ran into a billing/PO snag after their acquisition of NorthArc.
mike.sales: TL;DR — customer wants consolidated invoicing under Borealis legal entity, but NorthArc has an open PO and different vendor code.
rahul.legal: We need an addendum to swap billing entity + a PO acceptance clause. Can draft a 1-page addendum but need exact legal names and tax IDs.
sara.cs: I asked the customer for the new vendor code and the AP contact. They said AP will only sign a PO if pricing is unchanged.
tara.enable: FYI onboarding for NorthArc seats is mid-June. If billing sticks to separate entities we risk a delay in seat activation.
jordan.ops: If they request consolidated billing for Dedicated capacity, we need to confirm KMS/tenant mapping — mergers can affect key ownership.
emily.cs: Action items: (1) Rahul to draft addendum template, (2) Sara to collect vendor code + PO number + signer name, (3) Mike to confirm pricing stays the same, (4) Jordan to check ops impact for consolidation. ETA 48 hours?
rahul.legal: I'll put a draft in the shared folder today. It will include a single-sentence clause: "Billing entity substitution permitted upon mutual written addendum." Keep it minimal to speed signing.
sara.cs: Customer sent partial info: new vendor code is BOR-2024, AP contact is lena@borealis.com, signer is "Lena Ortiz, VP Finance". No PO number yet.
mike.sales: I confirmed pricing: they want no changes to seat price or term length. Sales OK with consolidated invoice as long as SLA/seat counts remain.
emily.cs: Great. Sara — once you have PO number, send DocuSign request. Use the addendum Rahul posts. Tag me on the envelope.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0a9f). Signers: Lena Ortiz (signer), Redwood CS (emily.cs) as counter-sign. Link: https://docusign.example/env_0a9f
sara.cs: Sent the envelope to Lena. She acknowledged receipt and asked for copy of the revised invoice layout before signing.
jordan.ops: For consolidated invoice layout, we need: billing entity name, tax ID, PO#, and list of account IDs mapped to line items. I can produce a sample PDF template.
emily.cs: Perfect — Jordan please attach sample PDF to thread. Rahul, after addendum is signed, legal please confirm if we need to issue a credit memo for any overlaps.
rahul.legal: Will confirm on credits after I see the PO and invoice dates. Probable no credit if term starts align. I'll aim to reply before EOD tomorrow.
sara.cs: Lena replied: "We can sign once we see invoice format + PO included" — asked for net30 terms to be preserved.
mike.sales: Noted. Finance already approved net30 for this account historically, fine to keep.
emily.cs: OK team — summary: 48-hour cadence, Sara owning customer comms, Rahul drafting addendum, Jordan producing invoice template, Mike backing pricing. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
